sources.quote: Today we are announcing a 64% price reduction on input tokens, a 52% price reduction on output tokens, and a 64% price reduction on incremental cached tokens for our strongest 1.5 series model, Gemini 1.5 Pro, [effective October 1st, 2024](https://ai.google.dev/pricing)
sources.supports: Google's official announcement establishes that Gemini 1.5 Pro had priced incremental cached tokens before the June 2025 models.dev schema correction. The quoted price change took effect October 1, 2024.

notes: The June 2025 models.dev commit describes a schema rename and removal of zero-valued cache fields; Google's announcement confirms that Gemini 1.5 Pro cached tokens had official pricing since at least October 1, 2024. The cited announcement does not state the resulting cache rate, so the official earlier-period cache price is left null; no June 2025 provider price change is evidenced.
